1.explanation:
• Accordion/Accordion.mdx — shows the current API surface and default styling of the Accordion (where the flush prop will be introduced).
• StructuredList/StructuredList.mdx and StructuredList/next/StructuredList.mdx — demonstrate the existing “flush” variant for StructuredList.  This is the reference implementation for how to structure the prop and remove padding, and will serve as the model for the Accordion’s flush alignment behavior.
1.bug_scenario:
The bug request is to introduce a new “flush alignment” prop on the Accordion component that removes its default left padding so that both the accordion titles and any expanded body content sit flush against the left divider lines (instead of being indented). In the provided images you can see two states:

• Closed state: all four accordion titles are flush to the pink guide line at the left edge of the horizontal dividers, with no left padding.
• Open state: when an item is expanded, both its title and its body text align flush to that same left divider line, with the toggle icon still at the right.  

Key elements involved:  
- The Accordion container and its default padding-left  
- The horizontal divider lines between items  
- The title text  
- The expanded body text  
- The toggle icon alignment
